# Contributing

1. Fork the repository and create a focused feature branch from `clf-c02-english`.
2. Write in clear American English and retain the CLF-C02 educational scope.
3. Preserve question identifiers, alternatives, and correct answers. Document necessary technical corrections with official AWS sources.
4. Use descriptive English filenames, preserve module numbering, and update every affected relative link.
5. Run the documentation checks described in the [English edition audit](../docs/english-edition/README.md).
6. Open a pull request targeting `clf-c02-english` with the problem, changes, and validation results.

Use the [bug report](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) for content errors or broken links and the [feature request](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) for proposed learning resources. Follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
